title: College board catches up
items: Made College Football's public scorecard show the eight relevant locked picks and their 6-2 graded record, without importing unrelated sports history.
Updated the CFB standings from current-season final scores and removed the stale prior-season playoff bracket while projections recalibrate.
Opened Community picks for every matchup during the seven days before kickoff, even when the model or market line is still pending.
Promoted college news into the main navigation and added a welcome notice explaining Matchday's college-focused shift.
Kept forecast publication active and removed the stale-payload path that could restore the paused banner.
